summary: The diff addresses REQ-1 and REQ-3 well, with actor-identity matching checks and proper loading/deferred states. REQ-2 (actor re-initialization on identity change, logout cache clearing) is partially addressed but not fully evidenced in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the backend actor used in all admin operations is always created with the authenticated Internet Identity principal, not an anonymous identity. Verify that useActor re-initializes the actor when the identity changes from anonymous to authenticated. Logging out resets the actor to an anonymous identity and clears relevant React Query caches.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows actorMatchesIdentity checks in useIsCallerAdmin and useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout to prevent stale-actor calls, but there is no evidence of changes to useActor itself being validated, nor any code showing logout clearing React Query caches (e.g., queryClient.clear() or queryClient.removeQueries on logout). No logout handler or cache invalidation logic is added elsewhere in AdminDashboard or a logout callback.

missing_requirements.requirement: Show a clear 'Access Denied' message in English if the admin check definitively fails.
missing_requirements.reason: The AdminDashboard.tsx is truncated so the access-denied state cannot be fully verified. The visible portion shows loading states in German but no English 'Access Denied' message is visible. REQ-3 explicitly requires the denied message to be in English.

hallucinated_features.description: Loading and connection messages in AdminDashboard are displayed in German ('Verbindung wird hergestellt', 'Initialisierung') rather than English for actor-waiting and loading states.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-3 specifies English for the access-denied message and does not request German-language loading messages; these were added without explicit requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: A 60-second timeout override is passed to useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout in AdminDashboard, while the hook default is 45 seconds.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not specify a particular timeout value; the 60s override was added without explicit requirement.
